name: Pixy Mood Tracker
tagline: Track your mood, one pixel at a time.
shortDescription: Pixy is a free, open-source mood tracker for iPhone and Android. Log moods, add notes and tags, and explore your history in a pixel calendar.
description: Pixy Mood Tracker helps you record your mood in a simple, colorful daily log. Add optional notes and tags, browse past days in a pixel calendar, filter entries, and view mood statistics. Mood entries are stored on your device. The app is free, and its source code is available under the MIT license.
